title: Professional writing tasks
summary: In a preregistered experiment with 453 professionals, access to ChatGPT improved performance on selected writing tasks.
caveat: Task-specific evidence, not proof that every kind of AI assistance improves all work.

title: Experienced open-source developers
summary: METR's randomized study observed experienced developers completing work more slowly with early-2025 AI tools than without.
caveat: A snapshot of specific developers, tasks, repositories and tools, not a universal statement about software development.

title: Story writing and collective novelty
summary: An online experiment found AI ideas boosted evaluated short-story creativity while making stories more similar across writers.
caveat: A limited creative-writing setting; originality, quality and diversity require distinct measures.
